title: DOW-UAP-D077, AARO Unresolved Case Analysis Update: Western United States Event
doc_notes: This is an AARO memorandum for record analyzing a UAP incident reported by federal law enforcement agents, which remains unresolved.

encounters.summary: Six federal law enforcement agents observed luminous orange 'mother orbs' releasing smaller red 'orbs' over a two-day period near a sensitive national security site.
encounters.entity_appearance: Luminous orange 'mother orbs' and smaller red 'orbs'.
encounters.entity_behavior: Mother orbs appeared for 1-2 seconds, released 2-4 red orbs, and disappeared; red orbs exhibited coordinated horizontal motion, altitude changes, and in one instance, remained stationary for several hours.
